snippet.title: Rescue Heli RH407 // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ►  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3440810/Rescue_Heli_RH407/

An arcade game with a retro vibe. Navigate a helicopter in 2.5D and rescue people waiting for transport. Don't overdo the aerial acrobatics -passengers might fall out! Land softly! And be quick -you're running out of fuel. The physical simulation of flight adds a modern twist to the retro gameplay.

Developed by 
G-REX games aka @G-REX_games
